opening: There was a basement in a little girl's house. Her parents, who were researchers, told her she must never open the basement door. One day she opened the door and was shocked.
solution: The little girl was the experimental subject locked inside the basement. When she opened the door, she saw the outside world and then realized she was the experimental subject.
canonical_facts: The little girl was locked inside the basement.
The little girl herself was the experimental subject.
